title: Portal
description: A door/gate joining two rooms, or joining a room to the instance EXIT. `position` sits on the shared wall plane of both rooms; `axis` is the wall normal; `size` is the opening [width, height].

roomB.description: Room id on the other side, or the literal "EXIT" for the instance exit.

axis.description: Wall normal direction. The portal opening lies in the plane perpendicular to this axis.
